name: Gerd Geradeaus
personality: He saves his energy for the exact moment everyone else would like some.
visual_intent: Wide compact ink pear with swept aerodynamic crest,furious delighted white eyes and two-upper-tooth open victory shout;lavender cycling cap with cream center stripe,small collar;holds ONE old drop handlebar with thick cream tape low at waist,full prop in cell
biography: He saves his energy for the exact moment everyone else would like some. He holds the handlebars as if the building could be steered into awarding him the final word. Residents are either leading or available as shelter from the wind. A dissonant card has made him thank the people behind him. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Er zieht durch. Wer gezogen hat, wird später festgestellt.

name: Klara Kletterklasse
personality: She fears the climb chiefly because it may eventually stop giving her a reason to be slow.
visual_intent: Tall thin wavering ink column,high side quiff and lashes,wide eyes looking upwards,small anxious CLOSED smile;cream cotton cap,small lavender scarf;holds ONE small toothed chainring like a cherished medal,other hand touches chest
biography: She fears the climb chiefly because it may eventually stop giving her a reason to be slow. Her chainring is a medal from a race that has not yet stopped climbing. HyperNorm classifies effort as impressive or too slow. A contradictory card suggests that difficulty and merit are different gradients, which she finds oddly comforting. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie kommt nach oben. Das Oben wurde vorsorglich erweitert.

name: Theo Taktstrich
personality: He rides against the clock because the clock does not ask follow-up questions.
visual_intent: Tall smooth bell ink blob with modest curled crest,one exacting raised eyebrow and pursed toothless side-mouth;lavender narrow headband and cream collar;holds brass stopwatch and a tiny blank oval race plate with no lettering
biography: He rides against the clock because the clock does not ask follow-up questions. He prefers the clock's blunt judgement to the courtyard's complicated expressions. His blank race plate identifies him without explaining him. A dissonant card has made him wonder whether a life can be timed accurately and still be misunderstood. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Zeit ist eindeutig. Das Ergebnis enthält trotzdem eine Person.

name: Dora Durstträger
personality: She supplies the entire team and receives thanks in theoretical form.
visual_intent: Broad round scalloped ink blob,soft modest lashes and heavily weary half-lidded stare,closed long frown;lavender cycling cap and small cream shoulder panel;holds TWO dented aluminum water bottles one in each goo hand,no extra bag clutter
biography: She supplies the entire team and receives thanks in theoretical form. She carries two bottles because the building considers support either invisible or insufficient. The leaders call this team spirit when they are thirsty. A dissonant card about receiving has persuaded her to keep one drink for herself. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie versorgt das Team. Der Dank wird im Windschatten nachgereicht.

name: Fritz Fluchtgruppe
personality: He calls leaving everyone behind a temporary act of collective interest.
visual_intent: Leaning upright comma ink blob with high wavy crest,sideways conspiratorial eyes and crooked toothless smirk;cream cap pushed back,tiny lavender neckerchief;one small rolled route map in hand and short little pennant tied to wrist,all within silhouette
biography: He calls leaving everyone behind a temporary act of collective interest. His rolled map promises a collective advantage located conveniently ahead of everyone else. HyperNorm calls departures initiative or betrayal depending on the result. He has begun looking back without pretending it is merely a tactical check. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Flucht dient der Gruppe. Ihr Abstand wird entsprechend begrüßt.

name: Kapitän Nachtritt
personality: He leads the group mainly by knowing which complaints can wait.
visual_intent: Wide tall asymmetrical blob,low falling ink crest,puzzled raised eyes and tiny toothless open exhale;old leather strip cycling helmet OPEN FACE,small lavender collar;holds one saddle as separate hand prop,other hand opens in weary appeal
biography: He leads the group mainly by knowing which complaints can wait. He carries the saddle as evidence that leadership is not necessarily comfortable. The building divides riders into direction and manpower. An ambiguous card has made him listen to the complaints before deciding which ones can wait. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Er führt die Gruppe. Sitzen war dafür nicht vorgesehen.
